name: 63017 · Chesterfield, MO
findings: ZIP 63017 (Chesterfield) has 280 nonprofit organizations. 123 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 100 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 63017 (Chesterfield) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
